title: Chama
gateBody: Chama stays off your menu until you choose to use it.
gateHint: If you already contribute to a circle — or want to start one — unlock Chama on this phone. You can still skip for now.
gateOptIn: I want to join a chama
unreadable: This saved circle cannot be read.
incomplete: The saved chama record is incomplete, so it was not applied.
fromEachLead: {amount} from each other member, paid to
staysOnAddress: This round stays on that address because a payment already went there.
custody: PesaSense does not hold the sats. A real address is paid from this phone's own wallet. A demo address is only a record.
noName: No chama name was entered on this phone. The round below is a demo record only. Nobody holds the group's money.
named: {name}: {amount} {cadence}. Payments come from your own wallet.
entered: {amount} {cadence}, from what you entered. Payments come from your own wallet. Nothing is sent until you pay.
waiting: Still waiting this round: {amount}. A finished round is just a record that every payer confirmed their own payment.
switchHint: A real circle uses each member's own phone. Switching here only changes whose confirmation you can record.
recordDemo: Record demo contribution ({amount}, no sats sent)
payOwn: This round pays {address}. Save this phone's own Breez address on your member profile, then pay from that wallet. This phone cannot pay for someone else.
othersPay: This round the others pay {address}. This phone does not send.
alreadyRecorded: {name} already recorded this round on their own phone.
receiveBody: When it is your turn, others pay this address. You can replace only your own.
reliabilityBody: After a round finishes, this phone can keep an opt-in note. It is not published.
keepNote: Keep a note for this phone
matchWallet: Pay from the wallet that matches this member's Lightning address.
needSats: This wallet has {balance} sats. About {needed} sats are needed.
useFailed: Could not use this wallet address.

errors.ownAddress: Use a Lightning address you control, like name@wallet.com.
errors.onlyMember: Only a member of this chama can do that.
errors.manyAddresses: This round has payments to more than one address.
errors.recipientDoesNotPay: The member receiving this round does not pay into it.
errors.ownReturn: This payment would return to your own Lightning address.
errors.roundChanged: This round changed before the payment could be recorded.
errors.noMembers: This chama has no members to rotate to.
errors.realAddress: This recipient uses a real Lightning address. Pay from your own wallet.
errors.positiveSats: A Lightning payment needs a positive whole sats amount.
errors.demoAddress: This is a demo address. It cannot receive sats. Record the demo contribution instead.
errors.taken: That Lightning address already belongs to another member.
errors.noteAfterRound: A reliability note is available after a round finishes.
